from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A named party involved in the case."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the person or entity, e.g., '李福臣'")
    role: str | None = Field(description="Their procedural role, e.g., '上诉人', '被上诉人', '被告'")

class FinancialItem(BaseModel):
    """A monetary amount mentioned in relation to fees, compensation, or distribution."""
    amount: str | None = Field(description="The amount mentioned, e.g., '50 元', '39360 元'")
    purpose: str | None = Field(description="What the money is for, e.g., '二审案件受理费', '赔偿'")
    borne_by: str | None = Field(description="Who bears or receives the money, e.g., '由陈丽芳负担', '向陈丽芳赔偿'")

class RulingOrder(BaseModel):
    """A specific command or decision in the judgment."""
    action: str | None = Field(description="The action ordered, e.g., '恢复原位', '赔偿', '驳回'")
    target_property: str | None = Field(description="Specific property or object mentioned, e.g., '卫生间', '通风管道'")
    recipient: str | None = Field(description="Who receives or is subject to the action")

class CaseDetails(BaseModel):
    """Specific identifiers linking to a judgment result."""
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="The court case number, e.g., '（2023）内 0204 民初 3983 号'")
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="The specific court name, e.g., '广州市越秀区人民法院'")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of case, e.g., '相邻关系纠纷', '继承纠纷'")

class JudgmentExtraction(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document."""
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="All parties named in the document")
    financial_items: list[FinancialItem] = Field(description="All monetary figures and their allocation")
    rulings: list[RulingOrder] = Field(description="Specific orders or verdicts pronounced")
    addresses: list[str] = Field(description="Any physical addresses mentioned")
    verdict_type: str | None = Field(description="Summary of the verdict logic, e.g., '维持原判', '驳回再审申请'")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt containing the key identifiers for matching")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentExtraction]
